outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrographs/density maps and 3D localization renderings (micrograph type), not a summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrographs/density maps and 3D localization renderings (micrograph type), not a summary plot requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot of number of clusters/cell per condition, showing mean ± SEM bars overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes per condition, showing mean ± SEM bars overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of % molecules in clusters per condition, showing mean ± SEM bars overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution localization and trajectory micrographs, not a summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel G contains a histogram of diffusion coefficients and a mean-square-displacement line plot; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph/other type illustrating individual molecule tracks), not a summary statistic plot requiring individual data point overlay.
